scientific_integrity: Proof derives full marked orientation law, degree CLT and extremes; all-size results analytic rather than inferred from enumeration. Prior existence probability and cluster frequency results explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Fair independent tournaments only; conditional large-size theorem; finite tests limited to n at most 6; the exponential TV rate is an upper bound, not asserted sharp. Prior 2026 work already gives obstruction-event and multiplicity asymptotics; no independent historical-priority certification.
title: Score-polarized rare exceptions to universal kingship in fair random tournaments
